[[File:Summon Boat icon (mobile).png|left|class=pageimage]]
'''Summon Boat''' is a spell from the [[standard spellbook]] that teleports their [[Boat|player-owned boat]] to the [[File:Docking_point_icon.png]] [[mooring point]] where they are currently located. This spell can only be cast after completion of [[Pandemonium]]. The spell requires the caster's boat to have a [[Teleport focus (facility)|teleport focus]] on it. The spell is one of the two [[boat spell]]s.

Much like the boat recovery service offered by [[Shipwright|shipwrights]], the boat's port task cargo, bounty items, salvage, and fish in the cargo hold will be '''lost''' when summoned.<ref>{{PlainCiteNews|url=https://secure.runescape.com/m=news/christmas-event-2025?oldschool=1|title=Christmas Event 2025|newsdate=10 December 2025|quote=When quick-transporting your boat - for example by recovering via a shipwright or using a boat spell - players will now only lose Port Task cargo, Bounty items, salvage and fish from their Cargo Hold. Anything else will be kept and accessible once your ship is recovered.}}</ref>

When cast, the player receives a menu to select which boat to summon. Any boats without a teleport focus will be greyed out. The last-used boat can be selected by pressing spacebar, and all subsequent boats via the number keys.

Casting the spell and summoning a boat does ''not'' have the same 55 Sailing requirement as building the teleport focus.
